title: Local quasi-finite projection with bounded relative dimension
statement: Let $B$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $g:Y\to B$ be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $y$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] of $Y$, and let $N\ge0$ be an integer such that every scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] of $g$ has topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] at most $N$. Then there are an affine open neighbourhood $U\subseteq Y$ of the image point of $y$, an integer $d$ with $0\le d\le N$, and a morphism $e:U\to\mathbf A^d_B$ [def-nagata-relative-affine-space] which is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] and quasi-finite (of finite type with finite discrete fibres, [pqf-def-quasifinite]), whose composite with the projection $\mathbf A^d_B\to B$ is $g|_U$.

source.place: Proposition 2.3, proof, printed p. 4 in the 28-page author version: first reduction by a quasi-finite projection; local copy WANTED.

mathlib_searches.query: A locally finite type morphism with fibre dimension bounded by N admits near a point a quasi-finite projection to affine space of dimension at most N
